audience: CMS dashboard users working inside a selected workspace

context.navigation: Dashboard sidebar navigation labels. Keep labels short enough for the Lumia dashboard shell.
context.shell: Lumia DashboardShell label bundle (UXR-6). Most strings are screen-reader-only (aria-label, aria-labelledby) — translators should keep them descriptive but short. ICU placeholders {unreadCount} and {title} are interpolated by next-intl at render time and must be preserved verbatim. Vocabulary for shared destinations (Access Control, Integrations, Settings) must match the Cross-App Navigation Vocabulary at xynes/xynes-infra/docs/research/ux-review/02-cross-app-navigation-vocabulary.md and stay aligned with the auth-app catalog (auth.dashboard.shell).
context.status: Authentication redirect placeholders shown briefly while the dashboard resolves auth state. Keep concise; tone matches loading affordances elsewhere in the app.
context.directories: Workspace content directory actions and errors. Directory lifecycle remains CMS-owned; keep error copy generic and avoid backend stack details.
context.a11y: ariaLabel values are announced by assistive technology and should describe the control, not the visual icon.

security.secretPolicy: Never include tokens, raw API keys, hashes, internal request ids, or stack traces in translated strings.
security.htmlPolicy: Messages are rendered as text. Do not add HTML markup to catalog values.
